scope: Static source-to-type associations only. Partial and representation bindings do not establish behavior parity.

bindings.Evidence: Update and WantedUltimately implement the numeric core of Immigration.Immigrator.update/getImmigrants; SettlementEntryRuntime.UpdateImmigration is the C# caller.
bindings.KnownGaps: UpdateImmigration has no caller in the game loop; happiness, population, civic boost, camps and standing power are not wired to original producers. Emigration and state saving are missing.

bindings.Evidence: Timer, AutoAdmit and Emigrants correspond to Immigrator.timer, autoAdmit and emmigrants; ImmigrationRuntime.State owns the per-race instances.
bindings.KnownGaps: The Java Immigrator saves all three fields per race; the C# state is not saved.

bindings.Evidence: The six enum members match the six cause declarations in CAUSE_ARRIVES; CitizenSystem stores the cause on creation and counts arrivals.
bindings.KnownGaps: The source cause objects also expose keys, labels and fromoutside; the C# enum retains only identities.

bindings.Evidence: The C# enum names the departure/death reasons declared by CAUSE_LEAVES and CitizenSystem records departure counters.
bindings.KnownGaps: Java CAUSE_LEAVE additionally stores source keys, death/natural/corpse flags and death indices; C# does not model those properties.

bindings.Evidence: SettlementEntryRuntime retains indexed, active and reachable border points as EntryPoints does.
bindings.KnownGaps: Java entry points describe border segments/directions and pick reachable positions; the C# record stores one cell per point.

bindings.Evidence: The C# race/type key indexes incoming counts; PeopleSpawner.IM stores per-type counts in a per-race array.
bindings.KnownGaps: This C# value type is a dictionary key, not a one-to-one port of the Java counter class; queue ordering and saved state differ.

bindings.Evidence: GameBootstrap calls Tick; SettlementEntryRuntime owns border reachability, incoming race/type counts and spawned arrivals. First arrival now uses positive accumulated time like PeopleSpawner.update.
bindings.KnownGaps: Java limits a spawner update to race count and cycles race/type cursors; C# sorts pending keys. Entry-point segments, immigration update wiring and save/load of queues/cursors remain different or missing.

groups.KnownGaps: Room service, patient and prisoner workflows require separate behavior review; file candidates alone do not establish that the jobs or saved state are equivalent.

Builder Covers and gate SetLocked lack game consumers. GateRuntimeInstance is a room-wide C# snapshot whereas ROOM_GATE.Instance is a Java singleton; item-level lock and path updates are missing. Janitor stock uses a simplified global demand.
The C# facilities aggregate Java station/job objects; per-cell reservations, job dispatch and persistence are not established by the class mapping. Temple prisoner sacrifice is still deferred.
Consumption lacks Java dirty-chunk accounting; road wear differs; RoomJobPositionsRuntime.Find is not called by the active room scheduler.
